description:
## [1.1.3](https://github.com/miketweaver/friendsturner-patches/releases/tag/v1.1.3) (2026-09-07)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **FriendsTurner:** Revert the any-version target from v1.1.1 and v1.1.2 and restore the 5.16 and 5.15 targets

patches.name: Disable license check
patches.description: Stops Google Play's integrity check from replacing the patched app with the "Get this app from Play" screen.

patches.name: Force sponsor state
patches.description: Sets the ad-free flag to true so every check that reads it takes the ad-free path. Covers the interstitial and the banner together, and any placement a future version adds. Makes the sponsor button read "Continue Sponsoring".

release_notes:
Reverts the version-target changes from v1.1.1 and v1.1.2.

Those were made on a wrong diagnosis: a phone appeared not to offer 'use the
installed app', and the cause was assumed to be Morphe's version filtering. It
was not. The option lives behind a different menu path.

Targets are back to 5.16 and 5.15, which restores the version Morphe recommends
when the app is not installed.

Patch behaviour is unchanged. Identical to v1.1.0 apart from the version number.
